name: lcd2004_pcf8574
title: 2004 character LCD on a PCF8574 backpack
description: A 20x4 HD44780 on the common I2C backpack (P0 RS, P1 RW, P2 E, P3 backlight, P4-P7 D4-D7): not a board of its own, a display any board's I2C bus can carry

ebay.source: Listings found by a search, not a purchase

levels.source: The usual backpack: the LCD takes 5 V, SDA and SCL are pulled up to VCC on the module. Not measured on a module.
